text: An old pirate's secret. Ahoy, captain. I'm Captain Sable. I was a pirate queen once, but now I'm retired and I keep space bees. Long ago, I hid a treasure.
Rust-Beard. But my old shipmate Rust-Beard has heard about it, the greedy old bucket. Follow my map clues and get there first!
The map. Each clue says how far to go from where you are. Find all three marks, then the treasure. And watch out for Rust-Beard!
Treasure! You beat Rust-Beard and found my chest! Gold coins, star-gems, and my old pirate hat. I'd forgotten how shiny it all was.
Shared treasure. Treasure is better shared, captain. Take your half, and this lucky coin. You'd have made a fine pirate. Luckily, you're an even better trader!
